description: This file defines the GENERATED Event Collector Grain class for Orleans, handling stream subscriptions, processing incoming events, and reporting results.

classes.name: GeneratedEventCollectorGrain
classes.description: An Orleans Grain that subscribes to a specific stream of GeneratedEvent, accumulates events, and reports results via a reporter grain.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes stream subscription; resumes or creates subscription handles.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles incoming batches of GeneratedEvent items, updates accumulator, and triggers reporting if necessary.
